# A link of the same main package with other flags must not replace the
# linker output that a cache hit replays.

go build -ldflags=-dumpdep -o a.exe main.go
stderr 'main.main'

go build -ldflags=-X=main.val=1 -o b.exe main.go
! stderr 'main.main'

go build -ldflags=-dumpdep -o c.exe main.go
stderr 'main.main'

-- main.go --
package main

var val string

func main() { println(val) }
